notes.title: Linux version, balance tweaks, fixes
Linux version, balance tweaks, fixes
Linux version, balance tweaks, fixes
notes.notes:
Hi guys! We're glad to share the latest Breached updates with you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24169824/69a668d32602f780abfa61a658a08ed9364ca5d4.png[/img]

- Linux version is finally here!
- Aberration toggle option works;
- Final statistics screen calculates opened entries correctly;
- We updated fuel synthesis mechanics and the balance is really different now. Less randomness, more tactics.
- Aaand a few more little tweaks.

Cheers!

notes.title: Breached update: #2
notes.notes:
Hi from devs again! More quick news for you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24169824/e71371dd3e49ce0ed96e1b18cd38711934cb2459.png[/img]

1) Finally, our Trading Cards have been approved! They serve as a part of the story and shed some light on hero's past.

2) Oculus users should experience no troubles with the forced VR mode launch.

That's all for now folks, have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Breached update: #1
notes.notes:
Hi from devs! Here's quick news for you guys.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24169824/3f71e0a046e93d8986103cf6942fb3a0a69379d3.png[/img]

1) Our friend tweaked Steam Controller to work very nice with Breached. Check out Breached Preset V1.0 if you have GabenPad.

2) Don't like Chromatic Aberration effect? Now you can turn it off in options. Thanks to all the guys requesting this feature today.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24169824/6fdba99232be9d63103be4f0b9f87a8a1b5e889e.jpg[/img]

That's all for now! Have fun!
